coverage.note: Only publicly announced dates and explicitly stated recurring schedules are listed. Undated future events are not guessed.

items.title: Fishing Tournaments Return
items.summary: Baby Cup, Fisherman’s Cup, and Pro Cup return. Official announcement says they start November 20, 2026; an end date has not been published.

items.title: Black Friday
items.summary: Special deals and offers announced for November 23–30, 2026.

items.title: Returning Community Items
items.summary: The Halloween announcement says other returning Community items remain available until December 18, 2026. The announcement does not specify every item or whether all items share identical availability.

items.title: Secret Base (jadwal rutin)
items.summary: Secret Base dijadwalkan kembali pada Kamis pertama setiap bulan, sesuai pengumuman resmi 31 Agustus 2026. Tanggal ini mengikuti pola rutin yang diumumkan; konfirmasi dalam game tetap disarankan.

items.title: Event Desember 2026 dan seterusnya (belum diumumkan)
items.summary: Belum ada tanggal resmi yang dapat diverifikasi untuk event musiman berikutnya seperti Christmas/New Year 2026–2027 atau event 2027. UGM akan menambahkannya saat diumumkan resmi.
